title: 把重要的东西放在我这儿吧
en: Keep the important things with me

ex.hz: 今天太阳很大，别忘了带伞。
ex.py: Jīntiān tàiyáng hěn dà, bié wàng le dài sǎn.
ex.en: The sun is strong today; don't forget your umbrella.
The school is on the west side of the park.

ex.hz: 妈妈生气了，因为我又忘了写作业。
ex.py: Māma shēng qì le, yīnwèi wǒ yòu wàng le xiě zuòyè.
ex.en: Mum is angry because I forgot my homework again.

ex.hz: 他的行李箱很大，也很重。
ex.py: Tā de xínglixiāng hěn dà, yě hěn zhòng.
ex.en: His suitcase is big and heavy.

ex.py: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ xiǎng zìjǐ zuò.
ex.en: I want to do this myself.

ex.hz: 我的包里有一本书和一瓶水。
ex.py: Wǒ de bāo lǐ yǒu yì běn shū hé yì píng shuǐ.
ex.en: There is a book and a bottle of water in my bag.

ex.hz: 我回到家才发现手机不见了。
ex.py: Wǒ huídào jiā cái fāxiàn shǒujī bú jiàn le.
ex.en: Only when I got home did I notice my phone was gone.

ex.py: Chū guó yídìng yào dài hùzhào.
ex.en: You must bring your passport when going abroad.
The plane takes off in ten minutes.

ex.hz: 出租车司机对这个城市很了解。
ex.py: Chūzūchē sījī duì zhège chéngshì hěn liǎojiě.
ex.en: The taxi driver knows this city well.

words.en: to draw; to paint; a picture

ex.hz: 老师把今天的作业写在黑板上。
ex.py: Lǎoshī bǎ jīntiān de zuòyè xiě zài hēibǎn shàng.
ex.en: The teacher wrote today's homework on the blackboard.

lines.hz: 你的行李箱准备好了吗？
lines.py: Nǐ de xínglixiāng zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?

lines.hz: 准备好了，我已经把衣服都放进去了。
lines.py: Zhǔnbèi hǎo le, wǒ yǐjīng bǎ yīfu dōu fàng jìnqu le.
lines.en: Yes, I've put all my clothes in.

lines.py: Hùzhào ne? Bié wàng le dài.
lines.en: What about your passport? Don't forget it.

lines.hz: 在包里。飞机九点起飞，我们六点就出门吧。
lines.py: Zài bāo lǐ. Fēijī jiǔ diǎn qǐfēi, wǒmen liù diǎn jiù chū mén ba.
lines.en: It's in my bag. The plane takes off at nine, so let's leave at six.

lines.hz: 你儿子画得真好，是谁教他的？
lines.py: Nǐ érzi huà de zhēn hǎo, shì shéi jiāo tā de?
lines.en: Your son draws really well. Who taught him?

lines.py: Méiyǒu rén jiāo, tā zìjǐ xué de.

lines.hz: 他需要什么东西吗？我可以帮忙。
lines.py: Tā xūyào shénme dōngxi ma? Wǒ kěyǐ bāng máng.
lines.en: Does he need anything? I can help.

lines.hz: 谢谢，他只需要多一点儿时间。
lines.py: Xièxie, tā zhǐ xūyào duō yìdiǎnr shíjiān.
lines.en: Thanks. He only needs a bit more time.

questions.q: Who taught the boy to draw?

grammar.en: Both go before the verb. 就 shows the speaker thinks something happens early, quickly or easily; 才 shows it happens late, slowly or with difficulty.

drills.q: 他七点___到学校了，比老师还早。
drills.en: He got to school as early as seven, even before the teacher.

drills.q: 电影七点开始，她七点半___到。
drills.en: The film started at seven, and she didn't arrive until half past.

drills.q: 这个字很简单，我看了一次___会写了。
drills.en: This character is simple; I could write it after seeing it once.

drills.q: 这本书很难，我看了一个月___看完。
drills.en: This book is hard; it took me a whole month to finish it.

drills.q: 我等了他一个小时，他___来。
drills.en: I waited an hour for him before he finally came.

drills.q: 现在才八点，你怎么___要走了？
drills.en: It's only eight; why are you leaving already?

grammar.point: A 把 B + verb + 在 / 到 / 给 + place or person
grammar.en: This 把 pattern says that something is moved to a place or handed to someone.

drills.en: Please put the book on the table.
I posted the letter to a friend.
My friend took me to the railway station.

drills.q: 他把照片放___我的包里了。
drills.en: He put the photos in my bag.

drills.q: 请你把这本书拿___图书馆去。
drills.en: Please take this book to the library.
I gave the present to Mum.

dialogs.q: 男的觉得女的来得怎么样？
女的把护照放在哪儿了？

lines: 我明天坐飞机去上海看朋友。
我的朋友把我的词典忘在家里了。

judge.text: 老师把作业写在黑板上了，你自己看吧。
我昨晚十二点才睡觉，所以今天起得很晚。
我的行李箱太重了，司机帮我把它放在了车上。
到了机场，他发现护照还在家里，很着急。

replies.q: 请把这本书放在桌子上。
